privacy_s1_body: This website is operated by Jeffery Asare, a fine art photographer based in Accra, Ghana. Contact: hello@jefferyasare.com.
privacy_s2_body: When you purchase a print, we collect your name, email address, delivery country, and chosen print format (Rolled or Framed) to fulfil your order and send your Certificate of Authenticity. When you sign up for the newsletter, we collect only your email address. When you submit a contact or commission enquiry, we collect the details you provide in the form.
privacy_s3_body: Your information is used solely to fulfil your order, send your Certificate of Authenticity, respond to your enquiry, and, if you signed up, send occasional updates about new work and print drops. We do not use your data for advertising or sell it to third parties.
privacy_s4_body: Payments are processed securely by Paystack. We do not store or have access to your card details. Paystack's privacy policy applies to all payment transactions.
privacy_s5_body: Order confirmation and Certificate of Authenticity emails are sent via Brevo. Newsletter emails are sent via Brevo. You can unsubscribe from newsletter emails at any time by replying to any email with "unsubscribe" in the subject line, or by contacting us directly.
privacy_s6_body: Order records are kept for the period required by Ghanaian tax and commercial law. Newsletter subscriber emails are retained until you unsubscribe. We delete your data on request where retention is not legally required.
privacy_s7_body: You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time. To exercise any of these rights, contact hello@jefferyasare.com.
privacy_s8_body: This site uses Cloudflare Web Analytics, a privacy-preserving analytics tool that does not use cookies, does not track individuals across sites, and does not collect personal data. No consent banner is required.
privacy_s9_body: This policy is governed by the laws of the Republic of Ghana. For users in the European Union, we are committed to compliance with the GDPR.
